paperBackground.grid: faint graph-paper grid, 40 px pitch, 1 px lines at ~7% opacity
paperBackground.vignette: radial, warm grey-brown: #D4CEC2 at ~88% radius, #BDB5AA in the corners; static
paperBackground.black: end section uses #000000 with no grid or vignette

blurOut.use: Old content leaving within the same page.
blurOut.behaviour: blur 0 -> 18 px and opacity 1 -> 0 over 2-3 frames

pagePush.use: Scene change. A new paper page with a torn leading edge slides over the old scene.
pagePush.edge: jagged torn edge with a white rim and a soft shadow on the old scene
pagePush.old: stays in place and blurs (0 -> 14 px) as it is covered
pagePush.new: content of the new page rides with it; the first headline word is already visible
pagePush.overlay: persistent corner tags stay on top and never move during a push

camera.pushIn: scale about a focus point, ease-out, 1x -> 3x in 6 frames

editing.pace: a new visual event every 0.3-0.6 s; holds never longer than ~1.2 s without at least the counter ticking
editing.cuts: no hard cuts; only blurOut within a page and pagePush between pages
editing.cadence: 20 fps animation on a 30 fps timeline (hold every third frame)
